summary.title: Build Your Own Web Server In Node.JS
summary.one_liner: You learn how HTTP works under the hood by coding a basic TCP and HTTP server in Node.js, then extending it with streaming, caching, compression and WebSockets.
takeaways: Understand HTTP as a protocol by building on raw TCP sockets in Node.js
Learn promises and event handling as used in Node network code
Implement HTTP request/response syntax and a basic HTTP server
Extend the server with dynamic content, streaming, range requests, caching and compression
Explore WebSocket and concurrency at the end of the book
summary.summary: This is an online book in the 'Build Your Own X' series that teaches HTTP by writing a web server from scratch in Node.js. Part I covers HTTP overview, TCP servers, promises and events, a simple network protocol, HTTP syntax and semantics, and coding a basic HTTP server. Part II covers dynamic content and streaming, file IO and resource management, range requests, HTTP caching, compression with the Stream API, and WebSocket with concurrency. The page also lists supplementary reading (High Performance Browser Networking and Eloquent JavaScript) and notes that PDF, EPUB and paperback editions are available for purchase.
